Es un índice orientativo de 0 a 100 basa: This is a heuristic index from 0 to 100 based on catalog metadata. It is displayed as a percentage to compare projects; it is not a measured probability or success rate.
No mide FPS, calidad gráfica ni resultad: It does not measure FPS, image quality or gameplay test results. Reviewed means the integration was reviewed; it does not confirm that every game version works.
Se usa la primera condición que correspo: The first matching condition is used, in this order:
Solo código fuente o herramienta de comp: Source code only or build tool
Constructor del juego a partir de archiv: Game builder using your own original files
Otros sistemas, sin Linux ni Windows: Other systems, without Linux or Windows
La fuente declara totalmente jugable o n: Source declares fully playable or native
Sin versión ni fecha conocidas, si no es: No known release or date, if not reviewed
Última versión de hace más de dos años: Latest release is over two years old
Versión publicada en los últimos 180 día: Release published within the last 180 days
Requiere originales, BIOS o preparación: Requires originals, BIOS or setup according to the catalog
El estado de la fuente y la antigüedad a: Source status and release age each apply one variant. The result is capped at 0–100. Source-only entries stay at 8 and receive no adjustments.
Los pesos son criterios de Deck Library;: The weights are Deck Library criteria; they have not been calibrated against installation or performance tests across the catalog. For example, Windows with a published release (50) and playable status (+3), without other adjustments, gives 53%, low.
